mapper.select: SELECT b.brand_id as brandId, b.brand_name as brandName, b.brand_logo_url as brandLogoUrl, NVL(LISTAGG(LOWER(c.brand_category_name), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.brand_category_name), '') AS brandCategories FROM Brands b LEFT JOIN Brand_Category bc ON b.brand_id = bc.brand_id LEFT JOIN Category c ON bc.brand_category_id = c.brand_category_id GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.brand_logo_url ORDER BY b.brand_id

SELECT brand_id as brandId, brand_name as brandName, brand_logo_url as brandLogoUrl, brand_description as brandDescription, brand_origin as brandOrigin, brand_mainphoto_url as brandMainphotoUrl FROM Brands WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT brand_id as brandId, youtube_video_id as youtubeVideoId, video_thumbnail_url as videoThumbnailUrl, video_description as videoDescription FROM Brand_Video WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}

SELECT product_id as productId, brand_id as brandId, sub_brand_id as subBrandId, product_name as productName, product_volume as productVolume, product_image_url as productImageUrl, product_description as productDescription FROM Product WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT sub_brand_id as subBrandId, brand_id as brandId, sub_brand_name as subBrandName, sub_brand_logo_url as subBrandLogoUrl FROM SubBrand WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
